description:
Advances: ancora.tasks

Wave 1 of ancora-gg8 (D items 1-3 in the investigation record; findings-DE and the architecture decision are comments there). No contract change — performance only; every existing golden/output test must pass byte-identical. Three pure-waste fixes no prior ticket names, measured on the atlas corpus (216 subjects / 2,086 requirements):

Deliverable:
1. Prime computes the status derivation once: Prime currently calls Status.build then Next.build, and Next.build calls Status.build again internally (lib/ancora/prime.ex:12-13, lib/ancora/next.ex:20-24) — the whole derivation runs twice. Thread the built status into Next (new arity or option), saving ~10-14s recorded-scale on the worst offender.
2. Hoist resolvable_ids out of the per-decision loop: Affects.maybe_unresolved/3 rebuilds the corpus-wide id MapSet once per decision (lib/ancora/decision_parser/affects.ex:54); 260 decisions cost ~829ms per Index.build, twice in spec.check. Build once per index build, pass it in.
3. Head-only ModuleLocator for report tasks: Status passes an empty ChangeSet (lib/ancora/status.ex:31) but ModuleLocator.build always scans head AND base (lib/ancora/derive/module_locator.ex:26-31) — a byte-identical duplicate scan. Skip the base side when the change set is empty; halves the measured ~2.9s for status/next/prime.

Spec delta: none. No requirement statement changes; behavior is contract-identical. (If the Next threading forces a public API shape change, keep Next.build/1 delegating so the task surface is untouched.)

Verification:
- Tests to pass: full existing suite, byte-identical golden output tests for prime/next/status/check.
- Behaviors to demonstrate: timing evidence before/after on the ancora corpus (and the atlas corpus via --root if available): prime ≈ next after threading; index build time drop from the hoist; status ModuleLocator time roughly halved. Record numbers in the IMPLEMENTED comment.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale plus targeted files, and mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: before IMPLEMENTED, full mix test plus mix spec.check --base <stage-base>, run-until-green.
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.check --base <stage-base> and targeted/--stale selections only; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Fixture/sandbox hygiene: async-safe fixtures, no cross-test leakage
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test
- Call-site Integration: the threaded status value's production caller is Mix.Tasks.Spec.Prime via Ancora.Prime; the existing prime golden test proves the path.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/gate.ex
- lib/ancora/derive/compare.ex
- lib/ancora/derive/extract.ex
- lib/ancora/tag_scanner.ex
- lib/ancora/output*.ex

Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/prime.ex
- lib/ancora/next.ex
- lib/ancora/status.ex
- lib/ancora/decision_parser/affects.ex
- lib/ancora/derive/module_locator.ex (empty-changeset skip only)
- lib/ancora/index.ex (only if the resolvable_ids hoist needs a pass-through)
- test/**

Out of Scope (intent):
- No parallelization (that is the wave-2 parallel-parsing ticket, sequenced after ancora-xla.3)
- No caching of any kind, in-memory-across-runs or on-disk (ancora-u38 is deferred by ruling)
- No output or flag changes; goldens must not change
- Do not touch anything in ancora-xla.3's scope (gate.ex materialize, compare.ex, extract.ex)

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: Perf: remove duplicate derivations in prime, status, and decision validation
